title: Local Company Gets National Industry Recognition | observernewsonline.com
text:
Event Solutions, a local business in Los Angeles, gets nominee for Best Spectacle, Fair or Festival by ACE/GALA Special Event Awards
LOS ANGELES - March 5, 2025 - PRLog -- Event Solutions , a leading event agency, is thrilled to announce its nomination as a finalist for the prestigious 2025 Special Event Gala Awards in the category of Most Outstanding Spectacle, Fair or Festival. This nomination marks the agency's third consecutive year of recognition by prestigious industry media companies, solidifying its position as a top innovator in the event planning world.
See the event that sparked the nomination here.
Building on their win at last year's Gala Awards, Event Solutions has consistently demonstrated excellence across a wide range of event categories. Their impressive track record includes recognition at:
Special Event Gala Awards/ACE Awards: Multiple nominations and wins, including this year's finalist position. BizBash Event Experience Awards: Honored at both the 10th and 11th annual awards in multiple categories. Canadian Event Awards: Recognition for outstanding event production.
Event Solutions has garnered acclaim for its expertise in delivering exceptional experiences in diverse categories, including: Best Multi-Day Event Best Product Launch Best Conference or Meeting Best Incentive Program Most Outstanding Spectacle, Fair or Festival (2025 Gala Awards finalist)
"We are incredibly honored to be recognized once again by the Special Event Gala Awards," said Brad Lipshy, CEO and Founder of Event Solutions. "This nomination is a testament to the hard work, creativity, and dedication of our entire team. We are passionate about creating unforgettable experiences for our clients, and we are thrilled to be acknowledged by our industry peers."
About Event Solutions:
Event Solutions is a full-service event planning and management agency that produces large-scale corporate events for Fortune 1000 companies. Founded in 1988, they offer comprehensive services from event design and production to venue scouting and logistics. Visit their website at https://eventsolutions.com/ for more information on their services.
